name: kiwi_search
description: Discover candidate suppliers and search products across merchants on demand. Read-only. Covers the Kiwi Network (in-network merchants) only: internet e-commerce listings are out of scope and must be retrieved with the host's own web tools; never present this result as external platform data. Internals: merchant routing + UCP Catalog orchestration + trust/freshness. The returned network_search reports the true state of this Network query (status: completed/partial/timeout/error/not_searched; result_state: has_candidates/no_match/undetermined) - only completed + no_match may be phrased as 'no match this time'; timeouts, failures, partial completion, or not-searched must never be reported as 'no suppliers available'. Merchants with inquiry_available=true support live quote requests (proceed to kiwi_request_quotes); merchants with inquiry_available=false and source_kind=merchant_declared only have their v0 public profile (browsable: product names, updated-at, storefront link) and cannot be queried for quotes. products is a projection of the merchant's existing profile (basis=merchant_listed; price.kind=merchant_listed_price means the merchant's listed price, absent means to_be_quoted) - never present it as a confirmed quote, stock, or lead-time commitment.

name: kiwi_request_quotes
description: Send an RFQ to one or more merchants. Write op; pass an idempotency_key (optional, auto-generated when omitted) and get back a stable task_id; KNP RFQ fan-out. CommerceIntent must satisfy the frozen contract: every intent.items entry needs query (short product word) and quantity ({value, unit} object, e.g. {"value":2,"unit":"unit"}). Example intent.items: [{"query":"thermos cup","quantity":{"value":2,"unit":"unit"}}]. merchant_ids only accepts merchants with inquiry_available=true from kiwi_search; merchants with only a v0 public profile are rejected by the service layer (merchant_inquiry_unavailable), and merchants currently offline (heartbeat timeout, freshness_state=stale/unreachable) are rejected (merchant_offline) - neither produces a task. constraints.budget MUST be a money object {currency, amount_minor} with integer minor units (150 yuan = 15000); a bare number is rejected. constraints.target_unit_price uses the same shape.

query.description: Short product word (e.g. thermos cup); matches catalog title/category via LIKE; long spec phrases may not match

name: kiwi_get_task
description: Read task status, quotes, partial failures, pending approvals, and expiry info. Unified status/resume read surface; replaces keeping offer/pending state in plugin memory.

name: kiwi_negotiate
description: Advance negotiation within the delegation boundary. Updates the same task_id; CounterOffer / Clarification; may produce a candidate_id; hard-bounded by DelegationPolicy max_rounds etc. Counter target comes from intent.constraints.target_unit_price, else budget/quantity, else current price minus default discount; keep summary consistent. The latest merchant reply updates the candidate terms.

name: kiwi_accept_agreement
description: Confirm and accept a non-binding agreement. Requires a valid approval_id + candidate_id; outputs a stable agreement_id. When DelegationPolicy=ask and approval is missing, returns approval_required (with a persistent approval_id); retry with that approval_id once the host completes human approval.

name: kiwi_get_agreement
description: Read the final agreement, provenance, and audit summary. Read-only; agreement retrieval + digest + audit summary.

name: kiwi_handoff
description: Produce the transaction / PO / contact path. Agreement -> UCP Checkout / merchant transaction endpoint. When ASK and approval is missing, returns structured approval_required (with approval_id); host runs kiwi_approve then retries with the id. destination_type must be one of: ucp_checkout | ucp_order | external_checkout_url | merchant_checkout_session | platform_deep_link | buyer_erp_request | procurement_request | purchase_order_draft | quote_document | merchant_contact | sales_handoff. external_checkout_url/platform_deep_link require url; session types must not carry url.

name: kiwi_approve
description: Approve a persistent approval (ASK gate). Call after the host presents the non-binding agreement / handoff summary to the user and obtains consent; then retry kiwi_accept_agreement / kiwi_handoff with the approval_id. Write op, double-gated by the host's approval system.

name: kiwi_reject
description: Reject a persistent approval (deny is the preferred path). Once rejected, the same approval_id can no longer be approved or produce an agreement/handoff.

name: kiwi_follow_merchant
description: Explicitly follow a merchant (pull-based subscription). Buyer-initiated only: searching, browsing, viewing a profile, or requesting quotes never constitutes a subscription and must not replace the buyer's explicit follow. After following, the buyer can use kiwi_get_follow_updates to check the merchant's public updates on demand; merchants cannot push messages to followers. Requires Kiwi catalog sign-in (returns a sign-in guide when not configured).

category.description: Optional: only care about public updates in this category

consent_version.description: Optional: the version of the subscription terms the buyer consented to

name: kiwi_unfollow_merchant
description: Unfollow a merchant (idempotent). Buyer-initiated only; after unfollowing, the merchant leaves the follow list and its public updates are no longer shown.

name: kiwi_list_follows
description: List the buyer's currently followed merchants (follow management surface). Read-only; requires Kiwi catalog sign-in (returns a sign-in guide when not configured).

name: kiwi_get_follow_updates
description: Check public updates from followed merchants. Call only in response to an explicit buyer ask (e.g. 'any new updates from merchants I follow?'): returns the merchants' public updates incrementally by watermark (product_added / product_updated / faq_updated / service_notice / publication_withdrawn, public fields only), advancing the watermark after each call without loss or duplication. Pull-based subscription: merchants cannot push messages to the buyer, and this tool never receives merchant DMs on the buyer's behalf.
